sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 19 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
19 OF 1985
SENATE (MEMBERS
FROM THE FEDERAL CAPITAL) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th March, 1985]
No. F. 17(3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Senate (Members from the Federal
Capital) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Manner of choosing of members of Senate from Federal Capital.- Members
of the Senate from the Federal Capital to be chosen under the Houses of
Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P. P.) O. No.
5 of 1977], shall be chosen in the manner laid down in the Senate (Members from
the Federal Capital) Order, 1973 (P. O. No. 12 of 1973), which shall apply for
the purpose with the modification that a reference therein to
"Speaker" shall be read as a reference to "Chief Election
Commissioner".
